# Utilivanta Tool

> Utilivanta Tool provides free, browser-based online utilities for text, time, and timing tasks.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://universal-respiratory.vercel.app/): Overview of the available free online tools.
- [Word Counter](https://universal-respiratory.vercel.app/word-counter.html): Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs; estimate reading time.
- [Case Converter](https://universal-respiratory.vercel.app/case-converter.html): Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, title case, and developer-friendly case formats.
- [World Clock and UTC Clock](https://universal-respiratory.vercel.app/universal-time.html): Check current time and compare time zones.
- [Online Stopwatch](https://universal-respiratory.vercel.app/stopwatch.html): Track elapsed time and lap splits; use the countdown mode.
- [Christmas Countdown 2026](https://universal-respiratory.vercel.app/christmas-countdown-2026.html): Countdown page for Christmas 2026.

## Notes

- These pages provide browser-based utility tools.
- Do not assume the website guarantees search-engine or AI-answer rankings.
- For current availability and behavior, access the linked page directly.
